name: Multi-Department Release & Cloud Infrastructure Governance
description: Deterministic DMN 1.3 decision table governing automatic vs. multi-department human-gated operations in Switch AI rooms.

rules.description: Hard invariant: Never allow public exposure when touching customer PII
outputEntries: "Hard compliance invariant violated: PII workload cannot have public network exposure"

rules.description: Hard budget cap: Reject any single tactical request exceeding $10,000/mo
outputEntries: "Tactical cost ceiling exceeded (> $10,000/mo); requires quarterly architecture board"

rules.description: Conservative AI guardrail: Below 0.80 confidence always escalates to human + departments
outputEntries: "Agent confidence below 0.80 threshold; escalated to Security, FinOps & Engineering Manager"

rules.description: Low confidence on non-PII public endpoint also escalates to CISO
outputEntries: "Low-confidence public endpoint change requires Security, FinOps & CISO approval"

rules.description: Production changes touching internal PII require multi-department review + CISO sign-off
outputEntries: "Production PII access requires parallel Security + FinOps review and CISO human sign-off"

rules.description: All production changes or medium-cost changes ($101..$10,000) require Security + FinOps + Eng Manager
outputEntries: "Production operation requires parallel @sec-agent + @finops-agent audit and @eng-manager sign-off"

rules.description: Staging/Dev changes over $100/mo or touching internal PII require multi-department review
Staging/Dev changes touching internal PII even at low cost require multi-department review
outputEntries: "Internal PII dataset usage in non-prod requires Security + FinOps review"

rules.description: Staging/Dev public exposure without PII over $100/mo requires department review
outputEntries: "Public non-prod endpoint > $100/mo requires Security + FinOps sign-off"

rules.description: Green Lane: Dev/Staging, cost <= $100/mo, no PII, confidence >= 0.80 -> 100% Automatic Approval
outputEntries: "Green Lane Fast-Track: Low-cost non-prod change with high confidence and zero PII"
